en: Give me a sec, I’m trying to figure out this puzzle.
ru: Секунду, пытаюсь разобраться с этой головоломкой.
meaning: to understand something or find the answer by thinking about it
ex: I can’t figure out where the key is.

en: I’m running out of ammo — cover me!
ru: У меня заканчиваются патроны — прикрой!
meaning: to use all of something, so there is none left
ex: We ran out of time.

en: Don’t give up, we’re almost there!
ru: Не сдавайся, мы почти дошли!
meaning: to stop trying to do something
ex: I gave up on this game last year.

en: Okay chat, I need to make a decision: left or right?
ru: Так, чат, мне надо решить: налево или направо?
meaning: to decide something (we say make, not do)
ex: It was a hard decision to make.

en: I was about to win, and then the boss one-shot me.
ru: Победа была в шаге, а потом босс убил меня с одного удара.
meaning: to be going to do something very soon
ex: The stream is about to start.

en: Sorry, I can’t keep up with the chat — it’s moving too fast.
ru: Простите, не успеваю за чатом — он летит слишком быстро.
meaning: to move or progress at the same speed as someone or something
ex: It’s hard to keep up with all the new updates.

en: We need to come up with a better plan.
ru: Нам надо придумать план получше.
meaning: to think of an idea, a plan or an answer
ex: Who came up with this name?

en: The boss is stunned — let’s take advantage of it!
ru: Босс оглушён — давай этим воспользуемся!
meaning: to use a situation or a chance to get something good from it
ex: Take advantage of the double XP weekend.

en: It’s worth trying one more time.
ru: Стоит попробовать ещё раз.
meaning: used to say that doing something is useful or will be good
ex: This game is worth playing with a friend.

en: I’m finally getting the hang of this weapon.
ru: С этим оружием наконец-то начинает получаться.
meaning: to learn how to do something, usually after some practice
ex: You’ll get the hang of it after a few games.
